results.title: 'Who cares about pain?': Injured silat exponent Aliff wins Sukma gold
results.description: SHAH ALAM: Selangor silat exponent Aliff Damien Mohd Redzuan pushed through severe pain in both knees and his left ankle to win the men’s solo gold medal in Sukma on Sunday.

results.title: Islam Makhachev defeats Ian Machado Garry with record 17th straight win at UFC 330
results.description: With the victory, Russia's Makhachev etched his name alone in the UFC record books, extending his winning streak to 17 consecutive fights and surpassing UFC ‌Hall of Famer Anderson Silva's historic 16-fight mark set from 2006-13.
